title: Describe an inference backend through the backend_describe recipe
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`, and works with the `backend_describe` recipe. Before Fangore wires a host, he wants a machine-readable description of a configured backend — name, network behavior, auth — without leaving the recipe catalog. He runs backend_describe with the mock backend and gets the same metadata the classic describe command used to print. Complements `fangore_harness_run_recipe`. He walks product steps (run_recipe) and verifies completion from the structured observation expects on this scenario.
implementation: Agentic Recipe catalog id `backend_describe` (`BackendDescribeTemplate`) with a single describe node. `BackendDescribeRunner` calls `InferenceStrategy.describe()` via DI. `CliInstrumentor` verb `run_recipe` calls `recipe_runner.run_backend_describe_recipe`. CLI `describe` / `recipes run backend_describe` share this path. Soft points: backend (required), model, base_url, api_key, describe_kind.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `describe_mock.yaml`: environment + graph + steps + complete expects.
